strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Pulogilamu ya van sales na ŵaguliski
strings.tierB.home.description: Pulogilamu ya ŵakugaŵa katundu: invoyisi na lisiti pa foni, stock ya galimoto, kuwunjika ndalama, nthowa na maulendo. Yikugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Longozgani ŵaguliski ŵinu kufuma pa ulendo wakwamba mpaka pa ndalama zakumalira izo zawunjikika
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ni pulatifomu ya cloud ya makampani ghakugaŵa katundu na ŵamalonda ŵa wholesale agho ghali na ŵaguliski ŵakwendakwenda (sales reps). Ŵaguliski ŵakulemba na kupulinta ma invoyisi na malisiti pa foni, ŵakulondezga stock iyo yili mu galimoto na kulemba maulendo, apo ŵalongozgi (ŵamanejala) ŵakuwona nyengo yeneyiyo ivyo vyaguliskika, ndalama izo zawunjikika na ngongole za ŵakugula.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoyisi pa foni ya muguliski
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Muguliski wakulemba invoyisi pa khomo la wakugula, na kuyipulinta pa pulinta ya Bluetooth (thermal) pambere wandafume mu sitolo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Kuwunjika ndalama na ngongole za ŵakugula
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Malipiro ghalighose ghakupokera lisiti ya nambala, yakulumikizgika na ma invoyisi agho ghakulipira, ndipo ngongole ya wakugula na sitetimenti ya akaunti yake vikusintha nyengo yeneyiyo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Udindo pa stock ya galimoto
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Stock ya galimoto yiliyose yikulondezgeka chinthu na chinthu: ivyo vyaŵikikamo, ivyo vyaguliskika, ivyo vyawelera na ivyo vyakhala, mwakuti kupambana kukuwoneka zuŵa lenelilo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Nthowa na maulendo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ulendo uliwose ukulembeka na malo, nyengo na vithuzi, ndipo nthowa ya muguliski waliyose yikulongoreka pa mapu ku mulongozgi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Yikugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Ŵaguliski ŵakulutilira kuguliska nanga palije netiweki. Vikalata vikukhala pa foni na kutumika vyekha para intaneti yawelera; chikalata chilichose chikufika kamoza pera.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashibodi ya pa intaneti ya ŵalongozgi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ivyo vyaguliskika, ndalama izo zawunjikika, ivyo vyawelera, stock na ntchito ya ŵaguliski pamalo pamoza, na maudindo na mazaza gha munthu waliyose uyo wakuyigwiliskira ntchito.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tiphalirani umo mukuguliskira
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Pemphani quotation panji maungano. Tikuwona ŵaguliski ŵinu, nthowa, katundu na ivyo mukukhumbikwira pa invoyisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Nozgani kampani yinu
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Ŵikani katundu, mitengo yake, ŵakugula na ŵaguliski, ndipo mu settings ŵikani ndalama na msonkho vya charu chinu.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tumani ŵaguliski mu nthowa
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Ŵaguliski ŵakuŵika app pa Android panji iPhone, ŵakuŵika katundu mu galimoto na kwamba kuguliska, kupulinta invoyisi na kuwunjika ndalama.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Londezgani zuŵa umo likuyendera
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashibodi ya pa intaneti yikulongora ivyo vyaguliskika, ndalama izo zawunjikika, stock ya galimoto na maulendo, apo ŵaguliski ŵachali mu nthowa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ni pulatifomu ya cloud yakulongozgera ŵaguliski ŵakwendakwenda mu makampani ghakugaŵa katundu na ŵamalonda ŵa wholesale. Yikusazgapo van sales (kuguliska katundu mu galimoto), route sales (kuguliska mu nthowa zakumanyikwa), pre-sales (kupokera ma oda pambere katundu wandafike) na DSD (kupereka katundu kufuma ku kampani mpaka ku sitolo). Ŵaguliski ŵakulemba invoyisi, ŵakupulinta, ŵakuwunjika ndalama na kulemba maulendo pa foni, apo ŵalongozgi ŵakulondezga ivyo vyaguliskika, ndalama izo zawunjikika, stock ya galimoto na ngongole za ŵakugula pa dashibodi ya pa intaneti.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: Kasi FieldSales yikugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Enya. App ya muguliski yikulutilira kugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti: muguliski wakulemba na kupulinta ma invoyisi na malisiti, wakulemba maulendo na kusazgirapo ŵakugula ŵaphya, ndipo vyose vikutumika vyekha, chilichose kamoza pera, para intaneti yawelera. Pali chinthu chimoza chakupambanako ku Saudi Arabia: makampani agho ghali kulumikizga ku e-invoicing ghakukhumbikwira intaneti pa nyengo yakulemba invoyisi panji chikalata cha katundu wakuwelera.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: Kasi FieldSales yikugwira ntchito mu vyaru vyuli?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales yikugwira ntchito na makampani ghakugaŵa katundu mu vyaru vyose. Kampani yiliyose yikuŵika ndalama na msonkho vya charu chake mu settings zake, ndipo ma invoyisi, malisiti na malipoti vikugwiliskira ntchito ivyo. FieldSales yili na ofesi yikuru ku Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, ndipo kwamba kugwiliskira ntchito FieldSales kukuchitika pa intaneti, kwizira mu maungano, WhatsApp na wovwiri wakutali.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Kasi FieldSales yikulumikizga na ma system gha boma gha e-invoicing?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Tikovwira kulumikizga kwa chigaŵa chachiŵiri na pulatifomu ya Fatoora ya ZATCA. Ichi chikukhwaska makampani agho ghali ku Saudi Arabia. Mu vyaru vinyake, kusazgapo Malawi na Zambia, FieldSales yikulemba ma invoyisi mu ndalama zinu na msonkho winu, ndipo kulumikizga na system ya charu ya e-invoicing kukusangika para mwapempha, tikati tawona namwe ivyo charu icho chikukhumba. Kuwalo kwa Saudi Arabia tikulayizga yayi kuti ma invoyisi ghazamuyana na ivyo charu chilichose chikukhumba.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Kasi app ya FieldSales yili mu viyowoyero vyuli?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Interface ya app ya FieldSales yili mu viyowoyero ivi pera: Chiarabu, Chingelezi, Chifulenchi, Chituluki na Chichayina. Yilije mu Chitumbuka. Ŵaguliski na ŵalongozgi ŵangasintha chiyowoyero cha interface, ndipo ma invoyisi agho ghapulintika ghangaŵa na chiyowoyero chachiŵiri pafupi na chiyowoyero chikuru. Mapeji gha webusayiti mu viyowoyero vinyake, kusazgapo peji ili la Chitumbuka, ni ghakung'anamulika pera kuti ŵanthu ŵamanye za FieldSales.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Kasi ningamba wuli kugwiliskira ntchito FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Pemphani quotation, pemphani maungano panji tilembirani pa WhatsApp. Tikusambira umo ŵaguliski ŵinu ŵakugwilira ntchito, ndipo tikumovwirani kuŵika katundu, mitengo yake, ŵakugula na ŵaguliski. Ŵaguliski ŵakuŵika app pa Android panji iPhone, ndipo ŵalongozgi ŵakugwiliskira ntchito dashibodi mu browser yiliyose. Mafoni gha smartphone pera ndigho mukukhumbikwira.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Interface ya app ya FieldSales yili mu viyowoyero ivi: Chiarabu, Chingelezi, Chifulenchi, Chituluki na Chichayina. Yilije mu Chitumbuka. Mapeji mu viyowoyero vinyake ghakulongosora FieldSales kuti ŵanthu ŵamanye pera.
strings.tierB.category.title: Pulogilamu ya van sales ya ŵakugaŵa katundu | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Pulogilamu ya van sales na route sales: invoyisi pa foni na pulinta, stock ya galimoto, kuwunjika ndalama na maulendo. Yikugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Pulogilamu ya van sales (kuguliska katundu mu galimoto) ya ŵakugaŵa katundu na ŵamalonda ŵa wholesale
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ni pulogilamu ya van sales ya makampani agho ŵaguliski ŵawo ŵakuguliska katundu mu galimoto mu nthowa zuŵa lililose. Muguliski wakuŵika katundu mu galimoto, wakuguliska pa sitolo yiliyose, wakupulinta invoyisi, wakuwunjika ndalama na kulemba katundu wakuwelera na app yimoza pa foni. Mulongozgi wakuwona ivyo vyaŵikikamo, ivyo vyaguliskika, ndalama izo zawunjikika na ivyo vyakhala mu galimoto yiliyose.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Kasi pulogilamu ya van sales ni vichi?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Pulogilamu ya van sales, iyo yikuchemekaso cash van panji route sales, yikulongozga nthowa ya kuguliska umo muguliski wakunyamula katundu mu galimoto ndipo wakuguliska, wakupereka, wakulemba invoyisi na kuwunjika ndalama pa ulendo umoza. Yikuŵa mu malo gha mabuku gha invoyisi gha mapepala na kuyimba foni namise. Yikulemba malonda ghalighose, malipiro ghalighose na katundu waliyose wakuwelera nga ni chikalata, mwakuti stock na ndalama viyaniskike zuŵa lenelilo. Ku mulongozgi, yikuzgora mafumbo ghatatu mise yiliyose: muguliski waliyose waguliska vichi, wawunjika ndalama zilinga, ndipo ni vichi ivyo vichalimo mu galimoto yiliyose.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Zuŵa limoza mu nthowa
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Zuŵa likwamba na kuŵika katundu mu galimoto kufuma ku stoo, ndipo ivyo vyaŵikikamo vikulembeka pa chikalata. Pa sitolo yiliyose, muguliski wakusankha wakugula mu app, wakusazgirapo katundu kufuma pa mndandanda panji barcode, wakulemba invoyisi na kuyipulinta pa pulinta ya thermal. Malipiro ghakulembeka na lisiti, ndipo katundu waliyose wakuwelera wakulembeka na chifukwa chake. Namise, ivyo vyakhala mu galimoto vikuweleskeka ku stoo. Pakati pa masitepu agha, mulongozgi wangalondezga ivyo vyaguliskika, ndalama izo zawunjikika na maulendo gha muguliski waliyose pa dashibodi, kwambura kuyimbira foni munthu waliyose.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yikugwira ntchito nanga netiweki yilije nkhongono
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Nthowa za kugaŵa katundu zikujumpha mu vipinda vya pasi, mu malo gha mafakitale na mu vikaya uko netiweki yilije nkhongono. App ya muguliski ya FieldSales yikusunga ŵakugula, katundu na mitengo yake pa foni, mwakuti muguliski wangalemba na kupulinta vikalata kwambura intaneti. Chikalata chilichose chili na nambala yake yapadera, mwakuti chikufika pa seva kamoza pera, nanga kutuma kungawerezgeka kanandi. Makampani gha ku Saudi Arabia agho ghali kulumikizga ku e-invoicing ghakukhumbikwira intaneti pa nyengo yakulemba ma invoyisi na vikalata vya katundu wakuwelera. Malisiti, maulendo na ŵakugula ŵaphya vikulutilira kugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti kwa iwo.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Kuwunjika ndalama na udindo pa galimoto
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Ndalama izo zikunyamulika mu nthowa zikukhumbikwira kulondezgeka nga ni stock. Malipiro ghalighose agho ghawunjikika ghakupokera lisiti ya nambala iyo yingalumikizgika na ma invoyisi agho ghakulipira, ndipo ngongole ya wakugula yikusintha nyengo yeneyiyo. Stock ya galimoto yikupendeka chinthu na chinthu: ivyo vyaŵikikamo kufumyapo ivyo vyaguliskika, kusazgapo ivyo vyawelera na masinthiro agho ghalembeka, mwakuti ŵalongozgi ŵangayaniska na kupenda kwanadi pambere muguliski wandawelere kunyumba. Katundu wakuwelera wangagaŵika mu mitundu itatu: wakuŵa makora, wakunangika panji wakusinthaniska, ndipo mulongozgi ndiyo wakusankha usange wakuwelera mu stock ya galimoto iyo yingaguliskika.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ni ya ŵanjani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales yikwenerera ŵakugaŵa katundu na ŵamalonda ŵa wholesale ŵa katundu wakuguliskika luŵiro nga ni vyakurya, vyakumwa, vyakutozgera na vyakupwelelera thupi, na kampani yiliyose iyo yili na ŵaguliski ŵakuyendera masitolo mu nthowa. Yikovwira van sales, ma oda gha pre-sales na DSD (kupereka katundu kufuma ku kampani mpaka ku sitolo). Ni ERP yakukwana yayi: yikulumikizga na system yinu ya accounting panji ERP kwizira mu API. Ŵalongozgi ndiwo ŵakusankha ivyo muguliski waliyose wangachita, nga ni kupereka discount, kuguliska pasi pa mtengo wa pa mndandanda panji kusazgapo ŵakugula ŵaphya.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Kasi van sales na pre-sales vikupambana wuli?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Mu van sales, muguliski wakunyamula katundu, wakupereka, wakulemba invoyisi na kuwunjika ndalama pa ulendo umoza. Mu pre-sales, muguliski wakupokera oda, ndipo stoo yikutumizga katundu pamanyuma. FieldSales yikovwira vyose viŵiri, mwakuti kampani yingagwiliskira ntchito cash van mu nthowa zinyake na kupokera ma oda mu zinyake. Mu vyose viŵiri, ma invoyisi, ndalama izo zawunjikika na ngongole za ŵakugula vili mu system yimoza, ndipo ŵalongozgi ŵakuviwona mu malipoti ghamoza.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Kasi ningayaniska wuli stock ya galimoto namise?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales yikulongora, pa chinthu chilichose mu galimoto yiliyose, unandi wa ivyo vyaŵikikamo, ivyo vyaguliskika, ivyo vyawelera na ivyo vyakhala. Yaniskani unandi wa ivyo vyakhala na kupenda kwanadi, lembani kupambana nga ni masinthiro ghakulembeka, ndipo weleskani ivyo vyakhala ku stoo pa ntchito yimoza. Galimoto yikwamba zuŵa lakulondezgapo na akaunti yakutowa iyo yikumanyikwa.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Kasi muguliski wa van sales wakukhumbikwira vichi?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Foni ya smartphone, Android panji iPhone. Pulinta ya Bluetooth (thermal) njakukakizga yayi, kweni yikovwira muguliski kupereka ku wakugula invoyisi panji lisiti iyo yapulintika. FieldSales yikuguliska foni panji pulinta yayi ndipo yikukhumba mtundu wapadera wa pulinta yayi. Ŵalongozgi ŵakugwiliskira ntchito dashibodi mu browser ya kompyuta panji foni yiliyose.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Kasi FieldSales yingalumikizga na system yithu ya accounting?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Enya. FieldSales yikupereka API iyo yikuzomerezga system yinu ya accounting panji ERP kusinthaniska na pulatifomu vyakukhwaskana na ŵakugula, katundu, ma invoyisi, malisiti na kusunthika kwa stock. Kulumikizga uku kukuzengeka na gulu linu panji na kampani yinyake iyo mwayisankha, kwizira mu vikalata ivyo vikulongosora API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales mu vyaru: ndalama, msonkho na e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales yikugwira ntchito na ŵakugaŵa katundu mu vyaru vyose. Wonani ndalama, msonkho na e-invoicing ya charu chilichose mu thebulo limoza.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales yikugwira ntchito na makampani ghakugaŵa katundu mu vyaru vyose. Kampani yiliyose yikusankha charu chake, ndalama na msonkho mu settings zake, ndipo ma invoyisi, malisiti na malipoti vikulondezga ivyo. Kulumikizga na e-invoicing ya boma kukugwira ntchito ku Saudi Arabia pera. Mu vyaru vinyake vyose kukusangika para mwapempha. Thebulo ili pasi likulongora, pa charu chilichose, ndalama izo zikugwiliskirika ntchito, msonkho wa malonda panji VAT uwo ukugwira ntchito kanandi, na usange kulumikizga na e-invoicing ya boma kukugwira ntchito panji kukusangika para mwapempha.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Tikovwira kulumikizga kwa chigaŵa chachiŵiri na pulatifomu ya Fatoora ya ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Ndalama na msonkho vikuŵikika na kampani yiliyose mu settings zake. Misonkho iyo yili mu thebulo ili ni ulongozgi pera, ndipo yingasintha; simikizgani malango ghasono na mulangizgi winu wa msonkho. Mzere (—) ukung'anamura kuti pa charu icho palije msonkho wa charu chose uwo walembeka.
strings.tierB.about.title: Vyakukhwaskana na FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales yikupanga pulogilamu ya cloud ya makampani ghakugaŵa katundu agho ghali na ŵaguliski ŵakwendakwenda. Yikamba mu 2026 ku Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (zina mu Chiarabu: فيلد سيلز) ni pulatifomu ya cloud ya makampani ghakugaŵa katundu na ŵamalonda ŵa wholesale agho ghali na ŵaguliski ŵakwendakwenda. Kampani ya FieldSales yikamba mu 2026 ndipo yili na ofesi yikuru ku Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Yikugwira ntchito na makampani mu vyaru vyose, ndipo ndalama na msonkho vya charu chilichose vikuŵikika mu settings za kampani yeneyiyo. Ŵakugula ŵithu ni makampani agho ghakuguliska na kupereka katundu kwizira mu ŵaguliski ŵa mu nthowa: ŵakugaŵa katundu, ŵamalonda ŵa wholesale na mafakitale agho ghali na magalimoto ghawo ghakuguliskiramo katundu.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Tikupanga system yimoza yakulumikizgika ya ntchito yose ya mu nthowa: ma invoyisi ghakupulintika kufuma pa foni ya muguliski, malisiti na ngongole za ŵakugula, udindo pa stock ya galimoto, nthowa na maulendo na malo na vithuzi, na dashibodi ya pa intaneti ya ŵalongozgi. App ya muguliski yikugwira ntchito pa Android na iPhone ndipo yikulutilira kugwira ntchito kwambura intaneti, ndipo yikutuma vikalata para intaneti yawelera. Makampani ghangalumikizga FieldSales na system yawo ya accounting panji ERP kwizira mu API, mwakuti vya mu nthowa vileke kulembeka kaŵiri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tikulongosora pulogilamu umo yiliri. Tikovwira kulumikizga kwa chigaŵa chachiŵiri na pulatifomu ya Fatoora ya ZATCA. Kulumikizga na ma system gha boma mu vyaru vinyake kukusangika para mwapempha. Interface ya app yili mu viyowoyero ivi: Chiarabu, Chingelezi, Chifulenchi, Chituluki na Chichayina. Yilije mu Chitumbuka. Kuti muyowoye nase, pemphani quotation, pemphani maungano panji tilembirani pa WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Yowoyani na FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Yowoyani na gulu la FieldSales: pemphani quotation, pemphani maungano panji tilembirani pa WhatsApp za pulogilamu ya ŵaguliski ŵakwendakwenda na van sales.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tiphalirani umo ŵaguliski ŵinu ŵakuguliskira lero na ivyo mukukhumba kusintha. Pemphani quotation, pemphani maungano panji tilembirani pa WhatsApp, ndipo munthu munyake wa mu gulu lithu wazamumuzgorani. Pa wovwiri, ŵakugula ŵithu ŵa sono ŵangagwiliskira ntchito nthowa izi nazo. Chikovwira para mwatiphalira charu chinu, unandi wa ŵaguliski, na usange ŵakuguliska katundu mu galimoto, ŵakupokera ma oda, panji vyose viŵiri.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Pemphani maungano pa intaneti na gulu lithu. Tizamumulongorani zuŵa la muguliski mu app na dashibodi ya mulongozgi, na viyelezgero vyakuyana na katundu winu na nthowa zinu, ndipo tizamuzgora mafumbo ghinu ghakukhwaskana na kunozga pulogilamu.
